how_pct_was_used: Used to highlight routes currently used by commuter cyclists and forecast the number of commuter cyclists under the government target; also included as an appraisal metric in the prioritisation process.
quotes_on_using_pct: Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT): This tool uses data from the 2011 Census to highlight routes which are currently used by commuter cyclists.

The PCT was also used to forecast the number of commuter cyclists on these routes under the government target (as set out in the Second Cycling and Walking Investment Strategy) to double cycling at a national level.
